name: HH daily auto-apply
prompt: Run the HH.ru auto-apply loop using the hh-apply skill. Read limits from skills.config.jobsearcher. Login with HH_LOGIN/HH_PASSWORD from env (never echo them). Prefer tab Для вас when use_recommended is true. Skip already_applied URLs and salary_too_low. Confirm each apply with ОТКЛИК ОТПРАВЛЕН or the click-type-submit sequence. Stop at max_applications. If nothing new to apply, respond with only [SILENT].
